summary.text: Tesa Schwans is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 9 who assumed office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A barber by profession, she was born in McLaughlin, South Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Tesa Schwans was born in McLaughlin, South Dakota.
She earned a high school diploma from Spearfish High School and a degree from Black Hills Beauty College in 1992, and her career experience includes working as a barber.
Schwans assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the House Commerce and Energy Committee and the House Education Committee.
